e63851771e3559d3863828c2e6235b428fc5b80a.sourceText: 链接器找不到 `swap` 函数的实现。
e63851771e3559d3863828c2e6235b428fc5b80a.translatedText: The linker cannot find the implementation of the `swap` function\.

e66ba190c3b4428894ac124045d0ee665a17cba2.sourceText: ​	在设计类的时候，属性和行为写在一起，表现事物
e66ba190c3b4428894ac124045d0ee665a17cba2.translatedText: ​	When designing a class, attributes and behaviors are written together to represent things\.

e67e0508beb055a0437a4642d7454f8da4c79a68.sourceText: `serial_comm` 直接把 `linear.x、linear.y、angular.z` 写入协议字段，按周期发送，没有用 JointState再换方向。MCU需核对四件事：线速度是否按云台系接收；机械相对 yaw 的零位与正负号；m/s与rad/s的单位；角速度是否已经包含自旋、是否会重复相加。当前没有核对MCU执行代码或实物响应，不能把上位机约定写成下位机已正确实现。
e67e0508beb055a0437a4642d7454f8da4c79a68.translatedText: `serial_comm` Directly write `linear.x、linear.y、angular.z` into the protocol field and send it periodically, without using JointState to change direction again\. The MCU needs to verify four things: whether the linear velocity is received in the gimbal frame; the zero position and sign of the mechanical relative yaw; the units of m/s and rad/s; whether the angular velocity already includes spin and whether it will be added repeatedly\. Currently, the MCU execution code or physical response has not been verified, so the host computer convention cannot be written as already correctly implemented on the lower computer\.

e6986639c19c690fdcd9ce69f93b4ea9cc511480.sourceText: `max_height=6.0` 的窗口很宽。若高处横梁等点通过上游和高差筛选，就会被压到二维地图中，即使车本来能从下面通过也可能形成障碍轮廓。应该根据底盘、云台活动包络与悬空结构核对要保留的高度，不能把它当模型尺寸；同时也不能只调小上限而漏掉障碍唯一可见的部位。
e6986639c19c690fdcd9ce69f93b4ea9cc511480.translatedText: `max_height=6.0`The window of  is very wide\. If points such as high crossbeams pass the upstream and height\-difference filtering, they will be projected onto the 2D map, and even if the vehicle could originally pass underneath, they may still form obstacle outlines\. The height to be retained should be checked against the chassis, the gimbal motion envelope, and suspended structures; it must not be treated as a model dimension\. At the same time, one must not merely lower the upper limit and thereby miss the only visible part of the obstacle\.
